description: This script is a shell script used for testing Git merge attributes and custom merge drivers, including setup, merging scenarios, conflict resolution, and error handling within a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success, runs commands, and reports results.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Switches branches or restores working tree files.

methods.name: git reset
methods.description: Resets current HEAD to a specified state.

methods.name: git config
methods.description: Gets or sets repository or global configurations.

methods.name: git ls-files
methods.description: Shows information about files in the index and working tree.

methods.name: git cat-file
methods.description: Provides content or type and size information for repository objects.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock used for testing time-dependent features.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Runs cleanup commands after test execution.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Asserts that a file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Runs a command expecting a specific exit code.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes lines to a specified file.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script with specified content.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of a test.
